title: AI usage
description: Historical and live token usage, API-equivalent estimates, and live reliability metrics.

list.name: origin
list.label: Origin
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT origin FROM llm.usage_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at) ORDER BY origin
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT origin FROM llm.usage_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at) ORDER BY origin

list.label: Provider
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT provider FROM llm.usage_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin) ORDER BY provider
list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT provider FROM llm.usage_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin) ORDER BY provider

  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin) AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider) ORDER BY model
list.definition:

options.content:
Usage from CLIProxy and imported Claude, Codex, Pi, and OpenCode sessions. Use **Origin** to choose live capture or a historical source. History stops when live capture began, so the two do not overlap. Missing historical usage cannot be reconstructed.

Historical records contain token counts, but not complete failure or latency data. Failure counts, connection counts, and latency panels cover live capture only. Input includes cache reads/writes; reasoning is already part of output.

**Cost is a current standard API-equivalent estimate, not your subscription bill.** Rates verified 2026-11-09; published long-context rates and recorded Claude cache-write TTLs are included. Unknown models or missing cache-write TTLs are unpriced. Speed, region, and tool fees are excluded. Totals cover priced calls only. [OpenAI rates](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing) · [Claude rates](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing)

panels.title: Recorded calls / attempts
panels.description: Historical token-usage records plus live calls, including live failures and retries. Missing historical calls are not estimated.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS value
FROM llm.usage_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider)
  AND $__conditionalAll(model IN (${model:singlequote}), $model)

panels.title: Failed attempts (live only)
panels.description: Upstream failures; not final client request outcomes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(failed) AS value
FROM llm.usage_metrics
WHERE origin = 'live' AND $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider)
  AND $__conditionalAll(model IN (${model:singlequote}), $model)

panels.title: Rate-limited attempts (live only)
panels.description: Attempts that returned an upstream HTTP 429.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(failure_status = 429) AS value
FROM llm.usage_metrics
WHERE origin = 'live' AND $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider)
  AND $__conditionalAll(model IN (${model:singlequote}), $model)

panels.title: Input cache hit rate
panels.description: Cached reads divided by all input tokens.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(cache_read_tokens) / nullIf(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS value
FROM llm.usage_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider)
  AND $__conditionalAll(model IN (${model:singlequote}), $model)

panels.title: Standard API equivalent
panels.description: Priced calls only. Not actual subscription charges. See unpriced calls beside this total.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sumOrNull(estimated_cost_usd) AS value
FROM llm.usage_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider)
  AND $__conditionalAll(model IN (${model:singlequote}), $model)

panels.title: Unpriced calls with tokens
panels.description: Calls with usage excluded from cost because the model rate or cache-write TTL is unavailable.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(isNull(estimated_cost_usd) AND total_tokens > 0) AS value
FROM llm.usage_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider)
  AND $__conditionalAll(model IN (${model:singlequote}), $model)

panels.title: Token breakdown
panels.description: Components sum to total tokens. Cache hits are not added to input twice; reasoning is not added to output twice.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval_ms(requested_at) AS time,
  sum(uncached_input_tokens) AS "Uncached input", sum(cache_read_tokens) AS "Cache read",
  sum(cache_creation_tokens) AS "Cache write", sum(output_tokens) AS "Output (includes reasoning)"
FROM llm.usage_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider)
  AND $__conditionalAll(model IN (${model:singlequote}), $model)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval_ms(requested_at) AS time, model, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens
FROM llm.usage_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider)
  AND $__conditionalAll(model IN (${model:singlequote}), $model)
GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time, model

panels.title: Daily tokens by provider (UTC)
panels.description: UTC calendar days; the first and last day follow the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(requested_at, 'UTC') AS time, provider, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens
FROM llm.usage_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider)
  AND $__conditionalAll(model IN (${model:singlequote}), $model)
GROUP BY time, provider ORDER BY time, provider

panels.title: Standard API equivalent over time
panels.description: Current standard API rates applied to captured usage. Unpriced calls are excluded; this is not billing data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval_ms(requested_at) AS time, model, sumOrNull(estimated_cost_usd) AS cost
FROM llm.usage_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider)
  AND $__conditionalAll(model IN (${model:singlequote}), $model)
GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time, model

panels.title: Successful call latency (live only)
panels.description: Successful attempts only. Zero or missing timings are excluded.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval_ms(requested_at) AS time,
  quantileOrNullIf(0.5)(latency_ms, NOT failed AND latency_ms > 0) AS "Median",
  quantileOrNullIf(0.95)(latency_ms, NOT failed AND latency_ms > 0) AS "p95",
  quantileOrNullIf(0.5)(ttft_ms, NOT failed AND ttft_ms > 0) AS "Median time to first token"
FROM llm.usage_metrics
WHERE origin = 'live' AND $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider)
  AND $__conditionalAll(model IN (${model:singlequote}), $model)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval_ms(requested_at) AS time,
  countIf(NOT failed) AS "Successful", countIf(failed AND failure_status != 429) AS "Other failures",
  countIf(failure_status = 429) AS "Rate limited"
FROM llm.usage_metrics
WHERE origin = 'live' AND $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider)
  AND $__conditionalAll(model IN (${model:singlequote}), $model)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Usage by model and provider
panels.description: Historical recorded responses and live calls. Failure and proxy connection counts cover live capture only. Cost excludes unpriced calls.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT provider, model, count() AS calls, uniqExactIf(trace_id, origin = 'live') AS live_proxy_traces,
  countIf(failed) AS live_failures, countIf(failure_status = 429) AS live_rate_limited,
  sum(input_tokens) AS input, sum(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read,
  sum(cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_write, sum(output_tokens) AS output,
  sum(reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning_subset,
  sumOrNull(estimated_cost_usd) AS standard_api_equivalent_usd,
  countIf(isNull(estimated_cost_usd) AND total_tokens > 0) AS unpriced_calls
FROM llm.usage_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider)
  AND $__conditionalAll(model IN (${model:singlequote}), $model)
GROUP BY provider, model ORDER BY input DESC

SELECT toDate(requested_at, 'UTC') AS day, count() AS calls,
  sum(input_tokens) AS input, sum(output_tokens) AS output,
  sum(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read, countIf(failed) AS live_failures,
  sumOrNull(estimated_cost_usd) AS standard_api_equivalent_usd,
  countIf(isNull(estimated_cost_usd) AND total_tokens > 0) AS unpriced_calls
FROM llm.usage_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(requested_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(origin IN (${origin:singlequote}), $origin)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN (${provider:singlequote}), $provider)
  AND $__conditionalAll(model IN (${model:singlequote}), $model)
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC
